title: CSF: Contextual Safety Filtering for Motion Generators
abstract: arXiv:2610.12467v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Text-conditioned motion generators produce trackable whole-body motion, but they have no notion of scene-dependent safety: the same action may target an object or a person. Existing safeguards either inspect the prompt, require labeled motion data, or enforce geometric constraints; therefore, they do not directly account for how scene context changes a motion's meaning. We introduce contextual safety filtering (CSF), a training-free filter that grounds natural-language safety rules in safe and unsafe reference trajectories produced by the generator. For each active rule, safe and unsafe reference trajectories define an affine safety value that a safe reference tracking CBF-QP enforces. Across four pretrained generators with different architectures, CSF activates the intended rules in all explicit and scene-triggered unsafe cases and reduces the danger-event rate by up to 90%, while preserving 88-100% of benign motions. translated_title: CSF：面向运动生成器的上下文安全过滤
translated_abstract: 文本条件运动生成器能够产生可跟踪的全身运动，但它们缺乏对场景相关安全性的认知：同一个动作可能指向物体，也可能指向人。现有的安全防护措施要么检查提示词，要么需要带标签的运动数据，要么强制执行几何约束；因此，它们没有直接考虑场景上下文如何改变运动的意义。我们提出了上下文安全过滤（CSF），这是一种免训练的过滤器，它将自然语言安全规则与生成器产生的安全和不安全参考轨迹相联系。对于每条激活的规则，安全和不安全参考轨迹定义了一个仿射安全值，由安全参考跟踪CBF-QP（控制屏障函数二次规划）强制执行。在四种不同架构的预训练生成器上，CSF在所有显式和场景触发的不安全情况下均能激活预期的规则，将危险事件率降低高达90%，同时保留88-100%的良性运动。
tldr: 提出免训练的上下文安全过滤框架CSF，将自然语言安全规则通过安全/不安全参考轨迹转化为CBF-QP约束，使文本条件运动生成器在场景触发的不安全情况下危险事件率降低高达90%，同时保留88-100%的良性运动。
en_tdlr: CSF is a training-free contextual safety filter that grounds natural-language safety rules in safe/unsafe reference trajectories enforced by a CBF-QP, reducing danger-event rates by up to 90% while preserving 88-100% of benign motions across text-conditioned motion generators.
